title: structural-debt-scan: exclude build/generated output (elm-stuff, committed bundles, s3-backup, *.min.js) + test
detail: The scanner's DEFAULT_EXCLUDES covers node_modules/dist/build/etc. but not elm-stuff, committed bundles (elm/main.js, public/main.js), or s3-backup-*; a scaleaircraftstuff run reported 96.4% duplication from 440 candidates that were all generated Elm bundles. Needs file-level excludes (committed bundles are not directories) plus a test. See docs/incidents.md [OPEN] "Structural Scans Must Exclude Build and Generated Output".

title: Audit incident [ENFORCED] entries that name no covering artefact (e.g. 102)
detail: Several [ENFORCED] entries assert a rule without naming the gate that covers it; verify each and either name the artifact or downgrade to [KNOWLEDGE]. Entry 132 was resolved 2026-09-20 (downgraded to [KNOWLEDGE]); 102 (Run Generated Output Immediately) is still unverified.
